versions.changelog: Reworked demand generation to use real 2011 Census ward-level worker counts as spatial weights across GHMC's real ward polygons, replacing the old subdistrict-level average. Found and fixed a real dead-zone bug: ~45 of GHMC's ~144 wards (mostly ones absorbed from Ranga Reddy district in 2007) had a real boundary but no matching Census figure, and were stuck at permanent zero job density. Added a landuse-derived proxy weight for those gap wards, clearly flagged as modeled rather than Census-sourced — 27 of 46 got a usable proxy, 19 remain a documented residual limit. Verified across two full production runs with exact conservation.

Fixed job totals, which were being calculated from GHMC's ward boundaries, covering about 66% of the map's population. Core IT hubs (HITEC City, Gachibowli, Financial District) were fine, but roughly 3.4 million people further out in Ranga Reddy and Medchal-Malkajgiri were getting zero jobs. Now using real 2011 Census worker counts across the full map area. Job total: 1,319,869 -> 3,116,289.
